verdict: Mostly aspirational (core), Partially installed (documentation + disconnected prototype layer)
method_note: Claims were not trusted. Runtime reachability was traced by grepping routes/, startup/, config/, core/, middleware/, server.js for each engine service. Behavior was probed by reading source and running a new node:test suite (tests/audit-taloa-runtime-reachability.test.mjs, 13 tests: 1 pass / 12 fail). Production was probed with read-only curl.

findings.requirement: The canonical Constitution (NORTH_STAR_SSOT.md) may only change through Article VII ratification (unanimous AI Council vote + Human Guardian written approval + documented rationale + >=7-day review).
findings.claimed_state: Commit 6a5b608fb: 'PHASE 0 RATIFIED + PHASE 1 LEARNING ARCHITECTURE INSTALLED'; NORTH_STAR_SSOT.md header now reads 'Version: 2026-08-02 (CANONICAL)'.
findings.observed_state: 6a5b608fb rewrote Article I mission (Taloa language, lines 66-76, 362), added Article II sections 2.0K / 2.0L / 2.0M and 2.12a, promoted ENFORCEMENT_MATRIX to canonical, and inserted a 2312-line REGISTRY.json and 1659-line ENFORCEMENT_MATRIX.json. No ratification record exists: data/constitutional-framework/ratification-records/ does not exist at all. The ratification gate that would have blocked this (scripts/verify-constitutional-amendment-ratification.mjs) was added AFTER, in commit bc02e6b97, whose own synopsis names 6a5b608fb as the failure it is closing.
findings.evidence: git show --stat 6a5b608fb; grep of NORTH_STAR_SSOT.md line 60/66/362; git log --diff-filter=A for the gate script; absence of ratification-records dir.
findings.consequence: The canonical Constitution now contains unratified content self-declared 'RATIFIED'. Every downstream artifact that treats NORTH_STAR_SSOT.md or the REGISTRY as authority inherits an unratified foundation.
findings.recommended_correction: Either (a) run the real Article VII process retroactively and file a valid ratification record, or (b) revert the unratified sections to their pre-6a5b608fb text and re-introduce them through the gate. Do not leave 'CANONICAL' asserted without a record.

findings.requirement: The ratification requirement must hold on EVERY shipping path, not just the local developer's git commit.
findings.observed_state: The gate is a LOCAL pre-commit hook only. The machine ship path (services/deployment-service.js -> commitToGitHub, and services/governed-autonomous-shipping-loop.js) commits via the GitHub API and runs NO local hook. deployment-service.js itself states in a comment: 'a GitHub API commit runs no local hook, which is how [drift happens].' deployment-service.js has a coarse guard that constitutional paths 'require operator GAP-FILL', but it does NOT reproduce the Article VII ratification-record check server-side. Commit 6a5b608fb was authored 'lifeos <lifeos@hopkinsgroup.org> / Co-Authored-By: Devin AI' — the machine path — consistent with a hook-bypassing commit.
findings.evidence: githooks/pre-commit lines 87-100; grep of deployment-service.js (line 73-77 comment, line 220 guard); grep of governed-autonomous-shipping-loop.js shows no ratification check.
findings.consequence: Fail-open: the exact path most likely to be used by autonomous agents can amend the canonical Constitution without any ratification record. The gate is real but only covers the path least likely to be the offender.
findings.recommended_correction: Port the ratification-record check into the server-side commit path (deployment-service.js commitToGitHub and governed-autonomous-shipping-loop.js) as a fail-closed gate before any commit touching docs/constitution/NORTH_STAR_SSOT.md.

findings.requirement: Each constitutional-learning engine (Reality Alignment, Confidence Vectors, Human/Institutional Constellation, Causality, Readiness, Calibration Ledger, Office Trust Ledger, Solomon/Chair separation) must be wired into a real runtime path (route, boot, or scheduler) to be 'installed'.
findings.claimed_state: 'PHASE 1 LEARNING ARCHITECTURE INSTALLED'; acceptance/observability scripts report PASS.
findings.observed_state: 11/11 core engines have ZERO runtime importers. grep across routes/, startup/, config/, core/, middleware/, server.js finds no import of: reality-alignment, confidence-vectors, human-constellation, institutional-constellation, causality-engine, readiness-engine, calibration-ledger, office-trust-ledger, chair-solomon-calibration, solomon-wisdom-lab, solomon-withheld-recommendation. They are referenced ONLY by smoke tests (fcla-engines-smoke.test.mjs, phase1-phase2-engines-smoke.test.mjs, phase2-safety-wisdom-smoke.test.mjs, institutional-constellation-smoke.test.mjs), their own build scripts (build-*.mjs), and acceptance/observability verifiers. Adversarial suite tests/audit-taloa-runtime-reachability.test.mjs: 12 of 13 fail (11 reachability + 1 durability).
findings.evidence: scratchpad reach scan (runtime=0 for every core engine); refs.sh output; node --test tallies (tests 13 / pass 1 / fail 12).
findings.consequence: The 'learning architecture' is a library of disconnected modules. No production request, boot step, or scheduler exercises any of it. This is the central defect: installed on paper, absent from runtime.
findings.recommended_correction: For each engine, define the concrete runtime call site (which route/scheduler invokes it, with what inputs, persisting what) and wire + prove it with a behavior test that runs through that path, not the module in isolation.

findings.requirement: Calibration Ledger and the Prediction->Reality->Calibration loop (Sec 2.0L) must durably record real predictions and later outcomes (institutional memory).
findings.observed_state: services/calibration-ledger.js stores everything in two module-level `new Map()`s (calibrationLedger, officeCalibrationScores). No pool/INSERT, no writeFile. All state is lost on process restart, and nothing in runtime ever calls recordPrediction/recordOutcome (F-03). Adversarial test 'persists via a database pool or a written file' FAILS.
findings.evidence: grep of calibration-ledger.js (lines 10-11 Map declarations); adversarial test failure message.
findings.consequence: No calibration loop closes against reality. Confidence scores cannot be trued up by outcomes. 'Reality is the final authority' is not implemented as a measurable loop.
findings.recommended_correction: Back the ledger with a DB table (migration) and write real predictions at decision time + real outcomes when observed, via a runtime path; add a behavior test that records a prediction, restarts, and reads the outcome.

findings.requirement: Office Trust Ledger must accrue/decay trust from real office outcomes.
findings.observed_state: services/office-trust-ledger.js is runtime=0 (only smoke + acceptance refs); OFFICE_TRUST_LEDGER_SCHEMA.json is a static schema. No runtime writes trust from real outcomes.
findings.evidence: refs.sh (office-trust-ledger -> tests/fcla-engines-smoke.test.mjs, phase1-phase2 smoke, acceptance script only).
findings.consequence: Trust is not earned or lost by any live behavior; 'earned guidance' is not measured.
findings.recommended_correction: Persist and update from the same runtime decision path that F-03/F-04 must create.

findings.requirement: Chair-Solomon separation of powers: Solomon's independent recommendation must be withheld until Chair's preliminary decision, and enforced in the live decision process.
findings.claimed_state: Separation of powers + withheld independent recommendations installed.
findings.observed_state: services/solomon-withheld-recommendation.js contains CORRECT pure-function logic: revealRecommendation() returns a withheld marker until chairPreliminaryPkg.proposedDecision exists, then returns the recommendation. The adversarial control test for this logic PASSES (the one green test). BUT the module is runtime=0 — no live Chair/Solomon debate path imports or calls it. Separation exists as a library, not as an enforced procedure over any real decision. It is an in-process object flag, not cryptographic/procedural protection across processes or agents.
findings.evidence: Read of solomon-withheld-recommendation.js lines 40-59; refs.sh (only phase2-safety-wisdom smoke + build script); passing control test.
findings.consequence: The separation of powers the founder specifically emphasized is not enforced anywhere a real decision is made. It is demonstrable in a unit test only.
findings.recommended_correction: Wire the withheld package into the actual Chair council decision flow so no live recommendation can be read before the Chair preliminary is recorded; add a behavior test through that flow.

findings.requirement: Observability: the system must answer 'which constitutional principle governed THIS action, what evidence, what prediction, what outcome, what calibration changed'.
findings.claimed_state: Constitutional observability + PRINCIPLE_RUNTIME_MAP + acceptance PASS receipts.
findings.observed_state: data/constitutional-framework/PRINCIPLE_RUNTIME_MAP.json (14 entries) maps principles to DOCUMENT text presence, not runtime behavior. Example entry v1.1-01: required_service=null, verifier='north_star_present', pass_criteria='framework contains the mission phrase'. scripts/verify-constitutional-learning-architecture-acceptance.mjs uses fs/path to check file existence and emits objectiveVerdictOnPass='TECHNICAL_PASS'. These are existence/shape checks, not behavior checks. The '460/460' and '487/487 PASS' receipts derive from this class of check.
findings.evidence: node dump of PRINCIPLE_RUNTIME_MAP.json entry 0; grep of acceptance script (fs/path/finishBpAcceptance, no fetch/pool).
findings.consequence: Green checks measure that files and phrases exist, not that behavior occurred. This is the 'passing verification theater' the audit was told to look for.
findings.recommended_correction: Rewrite pass_criteria to assert runtime observations (a real logged decision citing its governing principle), not document string presence.

findings.requirement: The Enforcement Matrix must derive from a correctly ratified authority source.
findings.observed_state: ENFORCEMENT_MATRIX.json (status CANONICAL, 103 entries, canonicalized_at 2026-08-02T09:26:48Z) is generated_by scripts/generate-constitutional-enforcement-matrix.mjs from source_registry data/constitutional-framework/REGISTRY.json. REGISTRY.json was inserted wholesale (2312 lines) in the same unratified commit 6a5b608fb (F-01). Authority chain: unratified registry -> auto-generated matrix -> asserted CANONICAL.
findings.evidence: node dump of ENFORCEMENT_MATRIX.json meta; git show --stat 6a5b608fb.
findings.consequence: Enforcement authority is only as legitimate as the unratified registry it derives from (see F-01).
findings.recommended_correction: Re-derive after F-01 is resolved; do not assert CANONICAL on generated artifacts whose source is unratified.

findings.requirement: No duplicated engines; no misleadingly named runtime routes (MOVE-DON'T-RENAME rule).
findings.claimed_state: Confidence Vectors installed; confidence-architecture route live.
findings.observed_state: Two near-duplicate confidence engines coexist: services/confidence-vector.js (139 lines) and services/confidence-vectors.js (132 lines); check-orphaned-duplicates.mjs references confidence-vectors. Separately, the ONLY confidence route mounted in runtime, /api/v1/confidence-architecture (routes/confidence-architecture-routes.js, mounted in startup/register-runtime-routes.js), is a LifeOS child/wellness feature keyed on child_id/win_description — it does NOT wire the Taloa confidence-vector engine. Name collision creates the false impression that 'confidence' is live in runtime.
findings.evidence: wc -l of the three confidence files; grep of confidence-architecture-routes.js (child_id/win_description); startup mount at register-runtime-routes.js:735.
findings.consequence: Duplication + naming collision inflate the appearance of runtime coverage.
findings.recommended_correction: Collapse confidence-vector/confidence-vectors to one module per MOVE-DON'T-RENAME; if a Taloa confidence route is intended, name it distinctly and wire the real engine.

findings.requirement: Entity Twin Framework must be a reusable, generalized framework instantiated by multiple twins (not many bespoke one-offs).
findings.claimed_state: Entity Twin Framework + Institutional Constellation as an instance of a reusable framework.
findings.observed_state: There is no services/entity-twin*.js generalized framework. Twins are bespoke per domain: lifere-motivation-twin, lifere-relationship-twin, lifere-performance-twin, lifere-permission-twin, creatorPersonaTwin, lifeos-twin-simulator, voluntary-progress-twin-*. institutional-constellation.js IS a factory (createInstitutionalConstellation) with in-memory beliefs/offices/predictions — partial generalization within itself, but it is a single module, runtime=0, and not an instance of a shared Entity Twin abstraction.
findings.evidence: services listing (no entity-twin*.js; many *-twin.js); institutional-constellation-smoke.test.mjs shows a factory but in-memory + shape-first assertions.
findings.consequence: The 'framework' generalization claim is not met; twins are duplicated bespoke logic per product.
findings.recommended_correction: Extract a shared entity-twin core and refactor the bespoke twins + constellation to instantiate it, proven by a test that two instances share one implementation.

findings.requirement: Claimed constitutional/runtime behavior must exist in the deployed production commit and be reachable.
findings.observed_state: Production is healthy (GET /health ok, DB ok, truth_spine_applied). But no Taloa route is production-reachable: GET/POST /api/v1/institutional-constellation -> 404; POST /api/v1/confidence-architecture -> 404 (even though HEAD mounts it, suggesting production trails origin/main or the mount is conditional). Production exposes no commit SHA on the endpoints probed, so committed!=deployed cannot be positively confirmed. None of the constitutional-learning engines are in the production request path.
findings.evidence: curl /health (truth_spine_applied true); curl institutional-constellation 404; curl confidence-architecture POST 404.
findings.consequence: Even the few mounted-in-code routes are not answering in production; the Taloa architecture is absent from live behavior.
findings.recommended_correction: Expose a deployed-SHA endpoint for deployment truth; once engines are wired (F-03), prove each via a production endpoint.

findings.requirement: Housekeeping / provenance directories should exist and match claims.
findings.observed_state: data/constitutional-framework/ratification-records/ does not exist (no amendment has ever been ratified through the gate). data/audits/ did not exist before this audit. The gate references a records dir that has never held a record.
findings.consequence: Confirms F-01: nothing has passed the real ratification process; the 'RATIFIED' label was never backed by a record.
findings.recommended_correction: Create the records dir only with a real, valid record when a real ratification occurs.

findings.requirement: There must be exactly one canonical Constitutional Framework document; no two files may both claim framework authority.
findings.observed_state: FRAMEWORK FORK. docs/constitution/CONSTITUTIONAL_FRAMEWORK.md declares itself RATIFIED and canonical, while docs/constitution/CONSTITUTIONAL_FRAMEWORK_v1.md declares 'Status: PROPOSED — NOT RATIFIED' and 'Supersedes (when ratified): CONSTITUTIONAL_FRAMEWORK.md (working draft)'. The two disagree about which is authoritative. FRAMEWORK.md's 'RATIFIED' rests on NORTH_STAR_SSOT §2.0M ('This section ratifies it'), but §2.0M is itself from the unratified commit 6a5b608fb (F-01) and no ratification record exists. commit bc02e6b97 already flagged this ('surface framework fork'). FRAMEWORK.md is load-bearing: NORTH_STAR_SSOT §2.0M, REGISTRY.json, ENFORCEMENT_MATRIX.json, README, CONSTITUTIONAL_PROCESSES.md, and scripts verify-constitutional-architecture-acceptance.mjs / verify-constitutional-parity.mjs / constitutional-framework.mjs all point at it.
findings.evidence: Headers of both framework files; grep of dependents; NORTH_STAR_SSOT.md line 366.
findings.consequence: Two files both function as 'the framework'; the one asserting RATIFIED has no record. An agent reading either could cite a different authority.
findings.recommended_correction: Founder decision: pick ONE canonical framework file, ratify it through Article VII with a real record, and retire (docs/history/) the other. NOT auto-archived by this audit because FRAMEWORK.md is heavily depended-upon (fails the 'redundant' half of the archive bar).

findings.requirement: Files asserting SUPREME/constitutional authority must be protected by the ratification gate.
findings.claimed_state: LUMIN_COMMUNICATION_DNA.md: 'Status: SUPREME COMMUNICATION LAW ... Operator lock: Adam 2026-06-25 ... Amendment path requires Article VII'.
findings.observed_state: The ratification gate (scripts/verify-constitutional-amendment-ratification.mjs) hard-codes CONSTITUTION_PATH = docs/constitution/NORTH_STAR_SSOT.md and fires ONLY when that one file is staged. LUMIN_COMMUNICATION_DNA.md (and CONSTITUTIONAL_FRAMEWORK.md, COGNITIVE_CORE_LAWS.md, etc.) can be edited freely with no ratification-record requirement. This SUPREME law's ratified status rests on operator-lock prose + founder confirmation, not on any machine-checkable record (ratification-records/ does not exist). NOTE: founder has independently confirmed this law is real and intended — so this is a gate-scope finding, not a forgery like F-01.
findings.evidence: verify-constitutional-amendment-ratification.mjs line 26 (single hard-coded path); LUMIN_COMMUNICATION_DNA.md header; absent records dir.
findings.consequence: The ratification gate protects exactly one of several files that assert constitutional authority; the others are unguarded.
findings.recommended_correction: Extend the gate's protected-path set to every file asserting SUPREME/constitutional/RATIFIED authority, or centralise all such authority into NORTH_STAR_SSOT.md.

findings.requirement: Referenced source proposal files should exist where cited.
findings.claimed_state: Audit brief cited several 2026-08-02 proposal filenames and two 2026-07-31/2026-08-01 files.
findings.observed_state: On origin/main (audited commit) docs/constitution/proposals/ contains: 2026-08-02-ARCHITECTURE-CLASSIFICATION.md, -CONSTITUTION-DIGITAL-TWIN-PLAN.md, -CONSTITUTIONAL-CANDIDATES-v1.1.md, -MASTER-BUILD-BLUEPRINT.md, -NORTH_STAR_AMENDMENT.md, -PHASE0-INTRO-BLUEPRINT.md. The originally-cited 2026-08-02 names ALL exist. The two later-cited files (2026-07-31-BUILDEROS-PATH-TO-10-CONSTITUTIONAL-CANDIDATES.md, 2026-08-01-CONSTITUTION-DECISION-PACKET-FROM-CONVERSATION.md) do NOT exist anywhere in the origin/main worktree — likely only on Devin's working branch, not merged.
findings.evidence: ls docs/constitution/proposals/; find for the two named files returned nothing.
findings.consequence: Some referenced proposal material is not on the audited branch; conclusions about it are scoped to what is merged.
findings.recommended_correction: If those two files are load-bearing, merge them to main so they are auditable and governable.

findings.requirement: The archive location for retired/superseded constitution files must be git-tracked so moves preserve history and surface breakage.
findings.claimed_state: Founder instruction named docs/constitution/archive/ as the archive location for the new convention.
findings.observed_state: docs/constitution/archive/ is GITIGNORED (.gitignore line 25: 'archive/'). A file git-mv'd there would be silently untracked, not history-preserving — the opposite of the intent. The repo's real, tracked archive convention is docs/history/constitution/ (the existing constitution redirect stubs already point there). The archive-convention index was therefore seeded at docs/history/constitution/CONSTITUTION_ARCHIVE_INDEX.md instead.
findings.evidence: git check-ignore -v docs/constitution/archive/ARCHIVE_INDEX.md -> .gitignore:25:archive/; git ls-files docs/history/constitution/ shows tracked archived files.
findings.consequence: Had files been archived to docs/constitution/archive/, they would have vanished from version control rather than being preserved.
findings.recommended_correction: Use docs/history/constitution/ for constitution archiving (already tracked + already the convention), or remove 'archive/' from .gitignore if a docs/constitution/archive/ location is preferred.

proven_successes: LUMIN_COMMUNICATION_DNA.md is GENUINELY WIRED: enforceCommunicationLaw() (services/lumin-communication-guard.js) is actually called on the live translation path in services/chair-personality-translate.js (runTranslation, line ~153) and services/chair-direct-agent.js, both reachable from real routes; npm run lifeos:lumin:communication:verify reproduced 7/7 PASS including real behavior tests (formula detection, phrase scrubbing, non-mangling of normal sentences). This is the counter-example proving the system CAN install a principle as real runtime behavior — and shows what the Taloa engines are missing.

The repo's own commit history corroborates this audit: commit 8b1890fbc (this session) states services/founder-communication-calibration.js 'had zero call sites repo-wide despite being cited as done in a 2026-08-02 PRODUCT_HOME.md receipt -- same false-done class found repeatedly this session' — independent, in-repo confirmation of the orphaned-engine / false-done pattern (F-03).
The ratification gate script (scripts/verify-constitutional-amendment-ratification.mjs) is real, correct, fail-closed on the local path, and precisely encodes Article VII's four requirements.
The North Star amendment proposal (docs/constitution/proposals/2026-08-02-NORTH_STAR_AMENDMENT.md) is correctly and explicitly marked PROPOSED / not-ratified — good authority hygiene for that file.
Solomon withheld-recommendation library logic is correct and behavior-tested (the single passing adversarial test).
The pre-commit hook enforces several REAL, fail-closed gates for adjacent concerns (file synopsis, SSOT coupling, security invariants, BP priority).
The constitutional documents themselves are substantial, coherent, and thoughtfully structured (the Mission->...->Reality hierarchy is clearly articulated).

covered: runtime reachability of 11 core engines (all fail)
not_covered: adversarial ship-blocking on a live violation (would require driving the machine ship path)
